source.quote: Audiophonics' own product page, read 2026-11-27, for its Raspberry Pi DAC board. Specification table: « Up to 32 bit 768KHz (Max 384 pour RPI) »; « DSD 64/128/256/512 DOP Auto Switch (Max DSD 128 pour RPI) ». The text gives per input: SPDIF « PCM jusqu'à 24/192 et DSD 128 DOP »; I2S « PCM 32Bit/768k et DSD 512 DOP ». Inputs: I2S on the Raspberry Pi GPIO, a second I2S header, one S/PDIF. Output: one stereo RCA at « 1.54V Vrms ».

_maker_terms: See brands/audiophonics.json: the maker's terms forbid reproduction; recorded on the project owner's decision of 2026-11-27, pending written permission.
_THE_RASPBERRY_PI_CAPS_IT_LOWER: The board's I2S takes 768 kHz and DSD512 over DoP, but fed by a Raspberry Pi the maker caps it at 384 kHz and DSD128 (« Max 384 pour RPI », « Max DSD 128 pour RPI »), and at 24/192 with the generic RPI-DAC driver. The i2s block carries the board's ceiling; the usual host is the lower one.
_DSD_IS_DOP_ONLY: Every DSD figure on the page is « DOP »: dop true, native_dsd not written.
